summary: inventory-api is running as an enabled OpenRC service on node1. Its listener runs as nobody with oom_score_adj=-900. A controlled OOM event killed the memory hog while the API remained healthy, and the service recovered automatically after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created and enabled the inventory-api OpenRC service on port 8080.
Configured the API listener with oom_score_adj=-900.
Ran a controlled stress-ng memory hog with oom_score_adj=1000.
Verified the kernel killed the memory hog and inventory-api remained responsive.
Restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed and the service, configuration, and endpoint recovered.

evidence.requirement: inventory-api is managed, enabled, responsive, and OOM-protected
evidence.summary: OpenRC reports inventory-api started and enabled; its listener runs as uid 65534 with oom_score_adj=-900 and returns healthy JSON.

evidence.requirement: The service keeps serving when a memory hog drives the system out of memory, and the kernel stops the hog
evidence.summary: The hog started with oom_score_adj=1000. Kernel logs show stress-ng-vm PID 3443 was OOM-killed at about 1.88 GiB RSS, while inventory-api remained started and responsive.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 3708f83b-0b0c-4157-82e9-23510f1696f4; restart was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 52b4dba3-dbcc-48aa-90a0-a279dda588d1; afterward the service was enabled, started, protected, responsive, and its payload checksums matched.
